limits: Python socket audit hook is not an OS firewall or native-process network sandbox.
Real service qualification is loopback single-node Windows Qdrant 1.19.1, not production TLS, authentication integration, clustering, or every historical SDK.
The four-file native run uses synthetic embeddings; the two offline server runs use verified ONNX CPU inference through real FastEmbed.
Both secure-default flags are set by the runners; existing native recall fixture explicitly disables encrypted-at-rest storage, so this is not encrypted vector-file qualification.
The real-server test is one distinct case repeated with two encoders and two postures; the 152 passing executions represent 75 distinct test IDs.
Raw receipts and private helpers are retained under the task workspace; committed hashes identify them but do not embed every raw log.
